This is the exact shape tauri-plugin-updater 2.11.0 parses (src/updater.rs, `RemoteRelease`'s Deserialize) and the exact shape app/scripts/package-app.sh --updater writes as latest.json. It is committed so the format has a home in the repository rather than only in a build directory; nothing fetches it, and the signature below is truncated. The url is the real shape a release publishes to: the asset lives under the TAG, while the endpoint every installed copy fetches is the unchanging https://github.com/RichSpark/RichOS/releases/latest/download/latest.json. An Intel build adds a darwin-x86_64 entry beside this one; one document carries every platform.
